note: PLACEHOLDER entries drafted from public frontline-training material (e.g. DHS Blue Campaign). Behavioral only — never demographic. Content owner: vet, source, and extend.

indicators.name: Companion answers for the traveler
indicators.description: A companion consistently answers questions directed at the traveler or controls the conversation.

indicators.name: No knowledge of own itinerary
indicators.description: Traveler cannot say where they are going, who they are meeting, or why.

indicators.name: Scripted or inconsistent story
indicators.description: Answers sound rehearsed, or key details shift across retellings.

indicators.name: Not in control of own documents
indicators.description: Passport/ID/tickets are held by a companion; traveler defers to them for paperwork.

indicators.name: Fearful deference to companion
indicators.description: Traveler checks with companion before answering; body language or voice suggests fear of the companion, not of authority.
